sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 529 (six loops, 167 campsites and 1 group camp parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. Reservations need at least 2 nights until DEC's season opens (May 8 in 2026, when its first campgrounds open): 'When the first campground opens for the season, the reservation minimums at all facilities will become 1 night until closing.' A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented. Equestrian sites H1-H22 need a horse on Memorial Day, Fourth of July and Labor Day weekends.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/luzerne/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=529 ('Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 nights. From July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights will be permitted at any campground'; 'On Memorial Day weekend, Fourth of July Weekend, and Labor Day Weekend, YOU MUST HAVE A HORSE TO CAMP IN THIS AREA') + https://dec.ny.gov/sites/default/files/2025-04/summerreccampgroundsummary.pdf (Luzerne RES MIN 2; reservation-minimum footnote), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DEC lists 173 sites; ReserveAmerica sells 167 campsites (21 of them the H equestrian sites with horse stalls) and a group camp: 6 listed at 40 ft, 153 at 30 ft, 9 at 20 ft.

sites.source: https://dec.ny.gov/sites/default/files/2025-04/summerreccampgroundsummary.pdf ('Luzerne 518-696-2031 173') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 529 (Equip length '40'/'40 Back-In' 6, '30'/'30 Back-In' 153, '20' 9; loop 'Sites H001-H022' 21), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 529 (all 167 campsites 'Electric Hookup - no', 'Full Hookup - no'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/luzerne/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=529 ('a trailer dump station and recycling center'; Services and Amenities: Dump Station, Shower Building, Showers, Water Fillup Station, Water Spigot), read 2026-10-21

note: NYSDEC campground on 51-acre Fourth Lake (no motorboats) near Lake Luzerne, off Lake Ave/NY-9N; rowboats and canoes. Also an equestrian area (sites H1-H22) with horse stalls in a pine grove, reserved for campers with horses on holiday weekends. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $22 + $5 non-resident, 2-night pre-season reservation minimum and phone (DEC 2026 summary), 2027 season May 14 - Sep 11 (DEC 2026 closes Sep 13), 173 sites to 40 ft, no electric, showers, dump (now manual). NEW: ReserveAmerica platform, 9-month window and 14-night max (were inherited), water spigots. Note: dropped site/length/facility/hookup/season/booking restatements and the MINIMUM STAY line (booking.min_stay holds it). Not stated: flush toilets (left derived), driveway type.
flags: Weak waterfront lead: ReserveAmerica says the campground 'partially surrounds Fourth Lake' while the entry is 'not waterfront' (RA also tags every site 'Near Water - no').
